examples.input: Plan a social media campaign for a new organic skincare brand launching in 2 months. Budget is $3,000/month. Target audience is women 25-40 who care about clean beauty. We have an Instagram with 500 followers and nothing else.

campaign_overview.objective: Brand awareness and email list building (pre-launch). Target: 2,000 Instagram followers, 500 email subscribers, and 50 pre-orders by launch day.
campaign_overview.timeline: 8 weeks — Phase 1: Foundation (weeks 1-3), Phase 2: Buzz Building (weeks 4-6), Phase 3: Launch (weeks 7-8)

content_pillars: Behind the Scenes (ingredient sourcing, formulation process, founder story)
Education (ingredient spotlights, skincare routine tips, clean beauty myth-busting)
Social Proof (customer unboxings, before/after results, testimonials)
Lifestyle (morning routines, self-care rituals, clean living)

sample_posts.concept: POV: You read the ingredient list on your moisturizer 😳 vs. reading ours 💚
sample_posts.format: Split screen, trending audio, text overlay showing ingredient comparison

sample_posts.concept: 5 ingredients in your skincare you can't pronounce (and what they actually do)
sample_posts.format: Educational carousel with clean design, save-worthy content

hashtag_strategy.trending: Monitor and incorporate 1-2 trending beauty hashtags per post

tiktok.recommendation: Start TikTok in month 2 after Instagram foundation is solid. Repurpose top-performing Reels as TikToks with platform-native editing.
tiktok.content_priority: Ingredient comparison videos, 'get ready with me' routines, founder story content

influencer_strategy.criteria: Clean beauty niche, engagement rate >5%, authentic content style, audience demographics match
influencer_strategy.deliverables: 1 Reel + 2 Stories per influencer, usage rights for 90 days
influencer_strategy.outreach_template: Provided — personalized DM referencing their specific content

examples.input: We're a B2B SaaS company (project management tool). Our LinkedIn has 3,000 followers but low engagement (0.5% avg). How do we fix this and generate leads from LinkedIn?

output.diagnosis: 0.5% engagement rate on LinkedIn is below average (2-3% is typical for B2B). Common causes: content is too promotional, posting company announcements nobody cares about, no employee advocacy, and generic industry content that doesn't stand out.

actions: Stop posting product feature announcements as standalone posts — nobody engages with 'We're excited to announce...'
Shift to founder/employee-led thought leadership — personal posts get 3-5x more reach than company page posts on LinkedIn
Content ratio: 70% value (insights, frameworks, hot takes), 20% social proof (customer stories told as narratives, not case studies), 10% product (only when tied to a problem-solution narrative)

sample_posts.copy:
We lost our biggest customer last quarter.

Not because of bugs or missing features.

Because our onboarding took 6 weeks.

Their team gave up after 2.

Here's what we changed (and why our retention is now 94%):

1. [Specific lesson]
2. [Specific lesson]
3. [Specific lesson]

The best product doesn't win. The easiest-to-adopt product wins.

---
What's been your biggest customer churn lesson? 👇
sample_posts.why_it_works: Vulnerability + specific numbers + invites engagement. Feels like a real person sharing, not a brand marketing.

actions: Identify 5-8 employees who are willing to post — provide them with weekly content ideas and first-draft assistance
Employee posts mentioning the company page get 8x more impressions than company page posts
Create a Slack channel for sharing content ideas and coordinating posting (avoid everyone posting the same thing on the same day)

lead_gen_integration.linkedin_newsletter: Launch a LinkedIn newsletter — subscribers get notified, creating a direct channel. Topic: weekly project management insights.
lead_gen_integration.content_to_demo_funnel: Every 4th post should include a soft CTA. Not 'Book a demo' but 'We wrote a free guide on [topic]. Link in comments.' Gate the high-value content for lead capture.
lead_gen_integration.linkedin_events: Host monthly LinkedIn Live sessions on topics like 'Remote Team Productivity' — collect registrant info as leads

kpi_targets.leads_per_month: 20-30 MQLs from LinkedIn content + gated assets

examples.input: Plan a Product Hunt launch campaign across social media. Our product is an AI writing assistant. Launch date is in 3 weeks.

actions: Create a 'Coming Soon' page on Product Hunt and start collecting subscribers
Post teaser content on X/Twitter daily: feature previews, behind-the-scenes, founder story
Engage authentically in AI/writing communities (r/ArtificialIntelligence, r/writing, Indie Hackers) — provide value, don't just promote
Reach out to 20-30 Product Hunt community members who've upvoted similar tools — personalized messages, not spam
Schedule launch announcement for your email list (send night before launch)
sample_tweet_sequence: Week 2, Mon: 'We've been building something for the past 6 months. Next week, it goes live. 🧵 Here's the story...' [Thread about the problem you're solving]
Week 2, Wed: Short demo video (30 sec) showing the product in action. 'This is what [Product] does in 30 seconds. Launching on @ProductHunt next [day].'
Week 2, Fri: 'We launch on @ProductHunt in [X] days. Here's what makes us different from ChatGPT/Jasper/Copy.ai: [3 specific differentiators]'

launch_day.timing: Launch at 12:01 AM PST (Product Hunt resets at midnight PST)
hour_by_hour: 12:01 AM PST: Product goes live. Post launch announcement on X/Twitter with PH link
6:00 AM PST: Send email to full list with direct PH link
8:00 AM PST: Founder posts personal story on LinkedIn about why you built this
10:00 AM: Post on Reddit (r/SideProject, r/startups) — genuine 'Show HN' style post, not promotional
Throughout day: Respond to every PH comment within 30 minutes. Engage on every social mention. Share real-time updates on X/Twitter (vote count milestones, user feedback)

actions: Share PH results and badges on all platforms
Publish a 'Lessons from our Product Hunt launch' blog post
Follow up with every PH commenter via DM — thank them, ask for feedback
Compile early user testimonials for social proof content

success_metrics.product_hunt: Top 5 Product of the Day, 300+ upvotes
